caption:
The coffee has that specific ozone aftertaste, but at least it's hot. That holographic koi seems to have lost its sense of direction, trying to swim through the traffic of the Neon District. It just bumped into a billboard and kept going, completely unbothered. I think I'll stay here until it finds its way back to the net.

#neotokyo #microcafe #holograms #citylife #coffeetime #urbanvibes #2097
